questions.question:
Seven different pieces are formed from equal small squares.
All seven pieces are used to assemble rectangles of different shapes. How many different perimeters can these rectangles have?

A parallelogram is divided in two parts $P_{1}$ and $P_{2}$, as shown in the picture. Which sentence is always true?
Choices:
A:$P_{2}$ has a longer perimeter than $P_{1}$
B:$P_{2}$ has a smaller perimeter than $P_{1}$
C:$P_{2}$ has a smaller area than $P_{1}$
D:$P_{1}$ and $P_{2}$ have the same perimeter
E:$P_{1}$ and $P_{2}$ have the same area

$A 10 \mathrm{~cm}$ long piece of wire is folded so that every part is equally long (see diagram). The wire is then cut through in the two positions marked. How long are the three pieces created in this way?
Choices:
A:$2 \mathrm{~cm}, 3 \mathrm{~cm}, 5 \mathrm{~cm}$
B:$2 \mathrm{~cm}, 2 \mathrm{~cm}, 6 \mathrm{~cm}$
C:$1 \mathrm{~cm}, 4 \mathrm{~cm}, 5 \mathrm{~cm}$
D:$1 \mathrm{~cm}, 3 \mathrm{~cm}, 6 \mathrm{~cm}$
E:$3 \mathrm{~cm}, 3 \mathrm{~cm}, 4 \mathrm{~cm}$

The figure shown on the right consists of one square part and eight rectangular parts. Each part is $8 \mathrm{~cm}$ wide. All the parts are assembled to form one long rectangle of width $8 \mathrm{~cm}$. How long is this rectangle?
Choices:
A:$150 \mathrm{~cm}$
B:$168 \mathrm{~cm}$
C:$196 \mathrm{~cm}$
D:$200 \mathrm{~cm}$
E:$232 \mathrm{~cm}$

Which of the five squares has the biggest proportion of black area?
Choices:
A:A
B:B
C:C
D:D
E:E

A panel consists of 4 circles. Touching a circle changes its color and the color of every circle touching it, from white to black or from black to white, as shown. Starting with all circles white, what is the minimum number of successive touches needed to turn all circles black?

The figure on the left is composed of the smaller three-square and four-square figures shown on the right. The smaller figures may be rotated but not turned over. What is the smallest number of three-square figures needed?

The star shown in the picture is made by fitting together 12 congruent equilateral triangles. The perimeter of the star is $36 \mathrm{~cm}$. What is the perimeter of the grey hexagon?
Choices:
A:$6 \mathrm{~cm}$
B:$12 \mathrm{~cm}$
C:$18 \mathrm{~cm}$
D:$24 \mathrm{~cm}$
E:$30 \mathrm{~cm}$
